causalFindings.star: Removing all star, star-race and terminal-urgency leaf terms changes zero root relations. Star preference is not the cause on this corpus.
causalFindings.attack: Removing attack geometry changes both historical regressions from candidate-higher to equal. Attack geometry is a necessary contributor to both known false positives, but removing it does not recover both historical improvements.
causalFindings.ordnance: Removing projectile and bomb terms changes both historical improvements away from their FULL candidate-lower relation, but only one becomes candidate-higher. This is not a safe standalone correction.
causalFindings.other: Mobility, status and history change several neutral roots but leave both regressions higher and both improvements lower. No single scalar family separates truth from error.
causalFindings.zeroLeaf: With all non-terminal leaf terms and history removed, 34 roots become equal and one remains lower. The observed direction is overwhelmingly leaf-driven rather than terminal or Hard-driven.

backupAudit.interpretation: The two true improvements are response tradeoffs, not pointwise dominance. A plain uniform mean recovers them but also keeps both regressions positive, so it cannot own actions. Independent row maximin and uniform mean are both insufficient classifiers.

retain: separate integer leaf families as diagnostic dimensions
reject: tuning the scalar star or attack weights from these 35 roots
replacing maximin with a uniform response mean
allowing any BP135 lane to own a production action
decision.next: BP136 builds one common 2xN simultaneous StageMatrix from the incumbent and candidate response vectors. It compares pointwise dominance, mixed-equilibrium support and risk-contaminated common-policy backup without changing search depth, physical rules or production ownership.
